reviewer_scope: context-free oral-level calibration with independent web search

nearest_prior_work: Data Mixing Laws, arXiv:2403.16952: earlier fitted mixture-response laws; RegMix differs through a broad ultra-small nonparametric swarm and rank transfer.
DoReMi, arXiv:2305.10429: one reference-plus-DRO proxy; RegMix uses parallel fixed-mixture proxies without a reference.
DoGE, arXiv:2310.15393: one gradient-influence proxy; RegMix learns a black-box response surface.
strongest_objections: Predictive mixture fitting is partly preempted by Data Mixing Laws.
Global rank correlation does not establish top-region selection validity.
Automatic baselines were transported across objectives and domain sets.

nearest_prior_work: DoReMi, arXiv:2305.10429: same proxy-to-target template with excess-loss DRO rather than gradient geometry.
Skill-It, arXiv:2307.14430: learned cross-skill influence and mirror descent from auxiliary interventions.
Learning to Reweight Examples, arXiv:1803.09050: one-step validation-gradient reweighting at example level.
strongest_objections: One-step score validation does not establish long-horizon causal utility.
Raw gradient inner products confound alignment, norm, and optimizer geometry.
The method composes known ingredients and has narrow target-scale evidence.
